source_date_if_available: Accessed April 2026; page undated (references Shutterstock acquisition of Envato "effective May 2024," placing publication post-July 2024)

snippets.snippet_text: "Although it may not have the sheer volume of content that Shutterstock offers, Envato is still a solid choice for designers and developers looking for all-inclusive pricing and unlimited access to high-quality creative tools. If your projects focus on design templates or specific creative assets, Envato may be the right fit, but for those seeking a broader range of high-quality content, Shutterstock remains the more versatile platform."

possible_subjects: Envato Elements vs Shutterstock buyer comparison: Envato suited for design templates and creative assets with all-inclusive pricing; Shutterstock described as more versatile for broader high-quality content range
